candidate.title: Dip-C
candidate.scope: The central Dip-C row of the assigned Illumina schematic: single-cell crosslinked-chromatin proximity ligation followed by META library preparation and the captioned haplotype readout. Hi-C labels the embedded contact-capture component and META is the embedded amplification component; neither is an additional target method. The cropped sciHi-C material above and separate SMDB row below are neighboring catalogue rows, with no branch or transfer into Dip-C. Primary-paper evidence supplies the explicitly identified sequencing-to-contact and phased-SNP interfaces needed to interpret the captioned algorithm. This is the depicted Dip-C implementation, not a complete execution protocol or a claim of applicability to every contact-capture variant.

method_scopes.rationale: The card title and central row identify Dip-C alone. The source row connects the Hi-C inset to dsDNA, META tagmentation and the final library. The paper explicitly calls the combined method Dip-C and supports sequencing and haplotype inference as its readout. Fixation is inferred from the labeled fixed/crosslinked states; sequencing and the phased-SNP data input are explicitly identified primary-paper additions for interpreting the diagram caption. There is no drawn split, pooling step, biotin-pulldown branch, or SMDB droplet connection in the Dip-C route.

checks.rationale: The complete central Dip-C route is represented: single-cell fixed chromatin, restriction digestion, proximity ligation without biotin pulldown, release of dsDNA, META end tagging and PCR to an adapter-bearing DNA library, followed by the explicitly identified paper-supported readout interface and captioned haplotype assignment.
